    OptionalsnapSources

    snapSources?: string[]

    Sources to snap against. Defaults to [options.source] so the existing single-source behaviour is preserved when omitted. Pass ['a', 'b'] to also snap onto another source (e.g. drawing in source A while tracing along reference data in source B).

    • Defined in src/core/handlers/draw-feature.ts:24

    snapThreshold?: number
